# Cromavolante

**Status: DRAFT** · world: [magneto](../lore/worlds/magneto.md) · kind: new · stage: space · id: `cromavolante`

## Niche

- **Habitat:** Upper canopy near iron-rich basalt forests & magnetic anomaly plumes. Evolves here because dense copper haze & frequent flares wash out visual contrast, while strong 0.8 mT fields provide stable 3D topology. Radical-pair cryptochromes exploit this gradient to navigate & hunt regardless of light.
- **Diet:** Electro-sensory plankton analogs, magnetotactic symbiont-rich grazers
- **Active:** Diurnal & crepuscular, flare-responsive
- **Predators:** none

## Body

Broad, torsion-stiffened wings with cryptochrome-rich retinal overlay; helical bone struts for magnetic stealth; ventral photophore patches for counter-illumination.

**Temperament:** Solitary, territorial, highly sensitive to field distortions.
